# FDGA011

> DO NOT use spaces after the opening parenthesis or before the closing parenthesis.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.2 Space Usage.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0055
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## Options

```ini
csharp_space_between_parentheses = false
csharp_space_between_method_call_parameter_list_parentheses = false

```

## From the book

```csharp
Right: Foo(myChar, 0, 1)
Wrong: Foo( myChar, 0, 1 )
```
